abstract: Consider a setting where N players, partitioned into K observable types, form a directed network. Agents’ preferences over the form of the network consist of an arbitrary network benefit function (e.g., agents may have preferences over their network centrality) and a private, or dyadic, component which is additively separable in own links. This latter component allows for unobserved heterogeneity in the costs of sending and receiving links across agents (respectively out- and in- degree heterogeneity) as well as homophily/heterophily across the K types of agents. In contrast, the network benefit function allows agents’ preferences over links to vary with the presence or absence of links elsewhere in the network (and hence with the link formation behavior of their peers). In the null model, which excludes the network benefit function, links form independently across dyads in the manner described by Charbonneau (2017) among others. Under the alternative, there is interdependence across linking decisions (i.e., strategic interaction). We show how to test the null with power optimized in specific directions. These alternative directions include many common models of strategic network formation (e.g., “connections” models, “structural hole” models etc.). Our random utility specification induces an exponential family structure under the null which we exploit to construct a similar test which exactly controls size (despite the the null being a composite one with many nuisance parameters). We further show how to construct locally best tests for specific alternatives without making any assumptions about equilibrium selection. To make our tests feasible, we introduce a new MCMC algorithm for simulating the null distributions of our test statistics.
abstract_zh: 考虑一个由N个参与者构成的有向网络，这些参与者被划分为K个可观测类型。参与者对网络形态的偏好包括一个任意的网络收益函数（例如，参与者可能偏好于其在网络中的中心性）以及一个私人的或二元的组成部分，该部分在自身链接上是可加性分离的。后者允许在发送和接收链接的成本中存在未观测到的异质性（分别对应出度和入度的异质性），以及跨K种类型参与者的同质性/异质性。

abstract: This paper studies the unemployment of physical capital—defined as idle units searching to be traded—and its macroeconomic implications. I provide evidence documenting that capital unemployment is large, volatile, and increases during economic downturns. I construct a capital-accumulation model that explains these patterns, with trading frictions in capital markets, which give rise to equilibrium capital unemployment, and financial shocks, which lead to large fluctuations in trading probabilities and capital unemployment. Using the model, I show that trading frictions and capital unemployment matter for aggregate dynamics. First, unemployed capital affects aggregate investment dynamics: Downturns characterized by large increases in unemployed capital are followed by investment slumps, because the economy tends to recover by absorbing existing unemployed capital rather than by producing new capital goods. Second, capital unemployment constitutes a propagation mechanism from financial shocks to economic activity, which shows up at the aggregate level as measured total factor productivity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究实物资本失业——即闲置且寻求交易的资本单位——及其宏观经济影响。我提供了证据，表明资本失业规模庞大、波动剧烈，并在经济衰退期间加剧。我构建了一个资本积累模型，该模型通过资本市场的交易摩擦解释了这些现象，这些摩擦导致均衡状态下的资本失业，而金融冲击则引发交易概率和资本失业的大幅波动。

abstract: A principal (such as a centrist political party) can partially influence the allocation of power between two competing parties. The principal is closer to one party, the ``Friend'', than to the other, the ``Enemy''. The principal's optimal contract initially seeks to exclude the Enemy. However, once the Enemy gains power, the principal embraces him in exchange for policy moderation. Moderation also disciplines the Friend, inducing him to move closer to the principal's preferred policy. Principals close to the Friend fully embrace the Enemy; more centrist principals divide their support. Commitment benefits the principal only if she is close to the Friend and parties value power little.
abstract_zh: 委托人（如中间派政党）能在一定程度上影响两个竞争政党之间的权力分配。委托人更倾向于其中一方，即“友党”，而非另一方，即“敌党”。委托人的最优契约起初旨在排除敌党。然而，一旦敌党掌权，委托人便接纳其以换取政策上的温和化。

abstract: We examine the association between permissible non-audit services provided by auditors and the timeliness of earnings announcements. Although earnings announcements are unaudited, audit progress influences management’s ability to release earnings while maintaining confidence in reported results. We posit that non-audit services generate earnings announcement timeliness benefits by improving the efficiency and timing of audits through knowledge transfer. We find that tax non-audit services are associated with timelier earnings announcements while nontax non-audit services are not. These benefits are concentrated in the pre-regulatory period before changes in the mid-2000s. Following these changes, the association persists for firms with weaker information environments, poorer performance, and greater audit-related challenges. Overall, our findings show that auditor-provided tax services are associated with enhanced timeliness of unaudited disclosures and that these benefits vary across firms and over time, highlighting previously undocumented spillovers from non-audit services with implications for academic research and regulation.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了审计师提供的合规非审计服务与盈余公告及时性之间的关联。尽管盈余公告未经审计，但审计进度影响管理层在保持对报告结果信心的同时发布盈余的能力。我们假设，非审计服务通过知识转移提高审计效率和时机，从而带来盈余公告及时性的益处。我们发现，税务类非审计服务与更及时的盈余公告相关，而非税务类非审计服务则无此关联。这些益处集中在21世纪中期监管变化之前的时期。在这些变化之后，对于信息环境较弱、业绩较差及面临更大审计挑战的公司，这一关联依然存在。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，审计师提供的税务服务与未经审计披露的及时性增强相关，且这些益处因公司和时间而异，揭示了先前未记录的非审计服务溢出效应，对学术研究和监管具有启示意义。

abstract: In this paper, we study the asymptotic bias of the factor-augmented regression estimator and its reduction, which is augmented by the $r$ factors extracted from a large number of $N$ variables with $T$ observations. In particular, we consider general weak latent factor models with $r$ signal eigenvalues that may diverge at different rates, $N^{\alpha _{k}}$, $0<\alpha _{k}\leq 1$, $k=1,\dots,r$. In the existing literature, the bias has been derived using an approximation for the estimated factors with a specific data-dependent rotation matrix $\hat{H}$ for the model with $\alpha_{k}=1$ for all $k$, whereas we derive the bias for weak factor models. In addition, we derive the bias using the approximation with a different rotation matrix $\hat{H}_q$, which generally has a smaller bias than with $\hat{H}$. We also derive the bias using our preferred approximation with a purely signal-dependent rotation $H$, which is unique and can be regarded as the population version of $\hat{H}$ and $\hat{H}_q$. Since this bias is parametrically inestimable, we propose a split-panel jackknife bias correction, and theory shows that it successfully reduces the bias. The extensive finite-sample experiments suggest that the proposed bias correction works very well, and the empirical application illustrates its usefulness in practice.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了因子增强回归估计量的渐近偏差及其缩减方法，该估计量通过从包含T个观测值的N个变量中提取的r个因子进行增强。特别地，我们考虑了具有r个信号特征值的通用弱潜在因子模型，这些特征值可能以不同速率发散，即$N^{\alpha _{k}}$，其中$0<\alpha _{k}\leq 1$，$k=1,\dots,r$。在现有文献中，偏差是通过使用特定数据依赖的旋转矩阵$\hat{H}$对估计因子进行近似推导得出的，该模型假设所有$k$的$\alpha_{k}=1$，而我们则针对弱因子模型推导了偏差。此外，我们使用不同的旋转矩阵$\hat{H}_q$进行近似来推导偏差，该矩阵通常比$\hat{H}$产生的偏差更小。我们还使用我们偏好的近似方法，即纯信号依赖的旋转$H$来推导偏差，该旋转是唯一的，可视为$\hat{H}$和$\hat{H}_q$的总体版本。由于该偏差在参数上不可估计，我们提出了一种分割面板刀切法偏差校正方法，理论表明该方法能有效减少偏差。广泛的有限样本实验表明，所提出的偏差校正方法效果良好，实证应用也展示了其在实际中的有用性。

abstract: This paper proposes a geometric model averaging (GMA) method in the framework of general likelihood estimation. Instead of using the classical weighted arithmetic mean, we consider a weighted geometric mean of the conditional probability density functions estimated from different candidate models, allowing both parameter uncertainty and model misspecification. The optimal weight is the minimizer of the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the true density to the weighted density. The geometric form of the weighted density makes it possible to find an approximately unbiased estimator of the KL divergence, and hence the optimal weight can be estimated consequently. Also, the geometric mean is naturally more applicable to density tail estimation than arithmetic mean due to its special form. The proposed GMA method provides a unified framework for a wide range of problems and is connected to many existing model averaging methods. When all the candidate models are misspecified, the weight of GMA is asymptotically optimal in the sense of achieving the lowest possible KL divergence. When correct candidate models are included, estimation consistency is established. Results of a comprehensive simulation study and two real data analyses show favorable performance of GMA relative to alternative model selection and model averaging methods.
abstract_zh: 本文在一般似然估计框架下提出了一种几何模型平均（GMA）方法。与传统的加权算术平均不同，我们考虑对不同候选模型估计的条件概率密度函数进行加权几何平均，从而同时纳入参数不确定性和模型误设。最优权重是使真实密度与加权密度之间的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度最小化的权重。加权密度的几何形式使得能够找到KL散度的近似无偏估计量，进而可估计最优权重。此外，由于其特殊形式，几何平均在密度尾部估计方面天然比算术平均更具适用性。所提出的GMA方法为广泛的问题提供了统一框架，并与许多现有的模型平均方法相关联。当所有候选模型均被误设时，GMA的权重在实现尽可能低的KL散度意义上渐近最优。当包含正确候选模型时，则建立了估计一致性。综合模拟研究和两项实际数据分析的结果表明，GMA相对于替代的模型选择与模型平均方法具有优越性能。

abstract: In a bug bounty program (BBP), organizations incentivize hackers—who could otherwise be “enemies”—to report security vulnerabilities by publicly offering monetary rewards. This paper develops an analytical framework to characterize BBPs and their strategic and economic impacts. Strategically, BBPs induce some hackers to self-select into cooperative vulnerability discovery and reporting, diverting them away from attacking (attack diversion) and delegating part of the protection effort to them (protection delegation). We show that (i) BBPs can be beneficial even when hackers are inefficient at vulnerability identification, yet more participants might make BBPs less attractive to firms. (ii) Although BBPs improve security, they might encourage competitive hackers (i.e., attackers) to exert more efforts. (iii) The coopetition dynamics can render a firm’s provision of rewards and in-house efforts socially inefficient. Common cybersecurity regulations, such as breach penalties and bounty reward subsidies, may exacerbate the inefficiency. We find complementarity between bounty subsidies and breach penalties, suggesting that combining and customizing them according to firm characteristics could enhance BBP efficiency. (iv) Contrary to the conventional wisdom that crowdsourcing rewards increase with participant size, we identify scenarios in which a firm should reduce or make nonmonotonic adjustments to a bounty reward as participant size increases. (v) Legal safe harbor for security testing or policies that reduce duplicate report submissions can lower firm payoffs under BBPs. We draw related implications for research and practice in information security and crowdsourcing. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Funding: This research is supported in part by the HKSAR General Research Fund Project 16503620. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682 .

abstract: Adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) by authors has accelerated production of academic articles and increased submission rates to journals, thereby straining review capacity and hurting journal outcome metrics, such as turnaround time and decision accuracy. Academic journals face an imperative to improve review quality and productivity by incorporating generative AI tools in the review workflow. As a concrete first step toward this idea, we outline a particular workflow that deploys large language models as a structured, trained, frontline reviewer. The workflow underlines that AI-produced evaluations must be transparent and contestable by authors. We emphasize the need for AI-infused peer review to be journal specific, designed for efficiency, accuracy, and accountability, within a human-in-the-loop oversight framework. We build a mathematical model of journal operations to compare outcomes under a status quo no-AI workflow and the proposed AI-infused workflow. The model captures how governed AI reconfigures human reviewer effort and illuminates conditions under which the AI-infused workflow can improve vital metrics, such as turnaround time and decision accuracy. Our essential point is that journals need to adopt a deliberate and institutionally governed approach for using AI in the review process. We recognize that identifying an “optimal” AI-infused peer review workflow or even definitively projecting the consequences of one will require substantial experimentation to calibrate and configure the workflow across multiple alternative designs. This discussion was accepted by Christoph Loch. Funding: D. Zantedeschi acknowledges support for this research from the Muma College of Business Dean’s Research Fund. abstract: This commentary responds to “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship” [Bhargava HK, Bana S, Zhang Z, Brandimarte L, Choudary V, Li F, Loupos P, Zantedeschi D (2026) Fighting fire with fire: Infusing AI into peer review to sustain quality scholarship. Management Sci. Forthcoming.]. It shares the paper’s core position, that journals should govern artificial intelligence openly rather than leave it to the shadows, but it questions the premise that rising submission volume poses an existential threat. The safeguard is human judgment. Our shared fatigue with derivative, repetitive work is a sensor more discerning than any AI detector, because a model trained on what we have already rewarded cannot produce the novelty that our community prizes. The threat to a journal like Management Science is thus more contained than the original alarm implies, provided AI remains a non-final input and humans retain ownership of novelty and contribution. One test should govern any AI workflow: does it ask more of human judgment, or less? This commentary was accepted by Christoph Loch.

abstract: This commentary responds to “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship” [Bhargava et al. (2026) Management Sci. Forthcoming.]. It supports the paper’s call for a governed approach to the use of AI in peer review. It argues that the key issue is not whether AI will enter peer review, but whether its use will remain informal and hidden or become transparent, auditable, and institutionally accountable. While endorsing journal-managed AI review as a response to the problem of “shadow AI,” the comment highlights several implementation risks, including AI hallucination, human accountability, authors’ perceptions of procedural dignity, and the evolving boundary between structured assessment and value judgment. It concludes that AI-assisted peer review should be treated as an important starting point for continued experimentation and refinement. This commentary was accepted by Christoph Loch.

abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being proposed as a tool to improve the efficiency of academic peer review. While such applications may alleviate reviewer shortages and enhance productivity, they largely preserve the existing architecture of scientific publishing. In this commentary I propose that AI also creates an opportunity to reimagine more fundamental aspects of how knowledge is evaluated and disseminated. Drawing on concepts from operations management and innovation, I propose disruptive alternatives that challenge the underlying design of the current process. Rather than simply helping referees review papers faster, AI may enable new models of scientific communication that are more open, timely, and adaptive to the needs of modern scholarship. This commentary was accepted by Christoph Loch.

abstract: Abstract Interracial marriage increased substantially in the late 20th century, concurrently with declines in regional and residential segregation. This paper studies whether these trends are related using two historical quasiexperiments and a stylized model of the marriage market. I use a shift-share instrument to find that the Great Migration increased interracial marriage in receiving communities, though this effect was absent in highly segregated cities. Using railroad density as an instrument, I also find that residential segregation decreased interracial marriage. Together, these findings indicate that internal migration and declining segregation contributed to the rise of interracial marriage in the non-Southern United States.
abstract_zh: 摘要 20世纪末，跨种族婚姻显著增加，与此同时，区域和居住隔离现象有所减少。本文通过两个历史准实验和一个婚姻市场的简化模型，探讨这些趋势是否相互关联。我采用份额转移工具发现，大迁徙增加了接收社区的跨种族婚姻，但在高度隔离的城市中这一效应并不存在。利用铁路密度作为工具变量，我还发现居住隔离降低了跨种族婚姻的发生率。综合这些发现，表明内部迁移和隔离程度的下降促进了美国非南部地区跨种族婚姻的兴起。
title: Migration, Segregation, and Interracial Marriage

abstract: Abstract Children’s mental health is the defining public health crisis of our time. Using the largest repository of private insurance claims in the United States, I provide the first systematic quantification of the variation in children’s mental health prescribing in the U.S. I separate variation due to 1) primary care provider (PCP) prescribing intensities, 2) regional practice environments, and 3) child health and demand. Equalizing PCP intensities would reduce the variance of provider prescribing rates by 50 percent for ADHD and 65 percent for antidepressants. Analyzing geographic variation alone significantly understates the extent of treatment variation and the role of providers.
abstract_zh: 摘要 儿童心理健康是我们时代决定性的公共卫生危机。利用美国最大的私人保险索赔数据库，我首次系统量化了美国儿童心理健康处方开具的变异情况。我将变异来源区分为：1）初级保健提供者（PCP）的处方强度，2）区域实践环境，以及3）儿童健康与需求。若使PCP处方强度均等化，注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的提供者处方率方差将减少50%，抗抑郁药则减少65%。仅分析地理变异会显著低估治疗变异程度及提供者的作用。

abstract: In 1981, President Mitterrand regularized the status of undocumented immigrants in France, who comprised 12 percent of the non-French workforce and about 1 percent of all workers. Employers have monopsony power over undocumented workers because the undocumented find it costly to participate in the open market. By alleviating this labor market imperfection, a regularization program can move the market closer to the efficient competitive equilibrium and increase employment and wages for the authorized workforce. Our empirical analysis reveals that the Mitterrand regularization program raised employment and wages for low-skill native and immigrant men and increased per-capita GDP.
abstract_zh: 1981年，法国总统密特朗对无证移民的身份进行了合法化，这些移民占非法国籍劳动力的12%，约占全体工人的1%。由于无证移民参与公开市场的成本高昂，雇主对他们拥有买方垄断权力。通过缓解这一劳动力市场的不完善，合法化计划能使市场更接近有效竞争均衡，并提高合法劳动力的就业率和工资。我们的实证分析表明，密特朗合法化计划提升了低技能本土及移民男性的就业与工资水平，并增加了人均GDP。

abstract: This paper investigates how the COVID-19 pandemic affected Italian firms’ expectations regarding future growth and prices, and the link between firm-level uncertainty and forecast errors. Using firm-level panel data from the Bank of Italy’s INVIND survey, we document that growth-expectation formation is stable across nearly three decades, including the COVID-19 pandemic, and that growth forecasts retain predictive content for realized outcomes in every year of the sample. Firms’ self-reported uncertainty about growth is informative about forecast accuracy in crisis years but not during 2020–2021, when uncertainty was driven by a common aggregate shock. At the aggregate level, cross-sectional disagreement among firms predicts the dispersion of subsequent realized outcomes, with predictability running only from expectations to outcomes. Workforce shortages are the dominant channel through which the pandemic disrupted firm expectations, more relevant than demand, supply, or financial channels. The price domain differs from real growth, with the response of expected prices to realized prices weakening during the late 1990s, the 2008–2009 financial crisis, and the 2022 inflation surge, while subjective price uncertainty remains a stable predictor of forecast errors.

abstract: Using three waves of household data from a randomised controlled trial involving 676 rice farmers in Hubei and Jiangxi provinces of China over the period 2017–2019, we estimate the causal effect of information provision on pesticide use and examine heterogeneity with respect to the duration of the intervention, farmers' human capital, and the identity and mode of information providers. The results reveal that 1 year of information provision did not reduce pesticide use intensity, whereas 2 years of provision led to a substantial reduction of 47.2%. This finding remains robust to alternative pesticide measures, sample winsorization, and different regional fixed effects specifications. The pesticide reduction effect is larger among farmers with higher levels of human capital. Information provided by government extension agents significantly reduces pesticide use, particularly when provided through face‐to‐face farmer training and retailer‐mediated dissemination. In contrast, identical information provided by pesticide firms has no significant effect, regardless of the intervention duration or provision mode. Moreover, the provision of pesticide‐reduction information lowers health risks for farmers and environmental risks to ecosystems from toxic exposure without compromising rice yield. These findings imply that future policies should prioritise sustained information provision targeting smallholders, strengthen intervention effectiveness for farmers with lower human capital, and enhance government extension services.
abstract_zh: 利用2017至2019年间针对中国湖北和江西两省676名稻农的三轮家庭调查数据，我们评估了信息提供对农药使用的因果效应，并考察了干预持续时间、农民人力资本以及信息提供者身份和方式等方面的异质性。结果显示，为期一年的信息提供并未降低农药使用强度，而两年的信息提供则显著减少了47.2%的农药使用量。这一发现在不同农药衡量指标、样本缩尾处理及不同区域固定效应设定下均保持稳健。人力资本水平较高的农民，其农药减量效果更为显著。政府推广人员提供的信息能显著减少农药使用，尤其是通过面对面的农民培训和零售商中介传播时效果更佳。相比之下，农药企业提供的相同信息无论干预时长或提供方式如何，均无显著效果。此外，提供减药信息降低了农民的健康风险及生态系统因有毒物质暴露所面临的环境风险，且未影响水稻产量。这些发现表明，未来政策应优先考虑面向小农户的持续信息供给，加强对人力资本较低农民的干预效果，并强化政府推广服务。

abstract: We study whether AI innovation changes labor-market polarization by weakening the relative position of high-skilled workers. We develop a CES production framework showing how AI affects the wage-cost ratio between high- and low-skilled workers through wage and employment margins. We test the model’s predictions using European regional labor-market data and find that AI reduces the relative wage-cost ratio by nearly 7 percent on average, with effects broadly split between wage and employment adjustments. These results are primarily driven by regions in countries highly specialized in AI technologies. Overall, our evidence suggests that AI may counteract the polarization effects associated with over two centuries of technological change.
abstract_zh: 我们研究人工智能创新是否通过削弱高技能工人的相对地位来改变劳动力市场的极化现象。我们构建了一个CES生产框架，展示了人工智能如何通过工资和就业两个维度影响高技能与低技能工人之间的工资成本比率。利用欧洲区域劳动力市场数据检验模型预测，我们发现人工智能平均使相对工资成本比率下降近7%，其效应大致在工资调整与就业调整之间平分。这些结果主要由在人工智能技术方面高度专业化的国家中的地区所驱动。总体而言，我们的证据表明，人工智能可能抵消与两个多世纪技术变革相关的极化效应。
title: AI innovation and labor market polarization: Evidence from European regions
title_zh: 人工智能创新与劳动力市场极化：来自欧洲地区的证据

abstract: This paper examines equity market reactions to the enforcement of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) on January 1, 2026. Using an event-study approach on a sample of S&P 500 and STOXX Europe 600 firms, we document three main findings. First, CBAM enforcement is associated with positive aggregate abnormal returns, consistent with the resolution of policy uncertainty. Second, both European firms and CBAM-exposed sectors experience lower post-event returns on average, reflecting compliance costs. Third, and most importantly, the interaction between geography and CBAM exposure shows that the impact of exposure is relatively more favorable for European firms compared to their U.S. counterparts. These results suggest that CBAM is perceived by financial markets as both a carbon burden and a competitive mechanism, with effects concentrated in the short run.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了股票市场对2026年1月1日欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）实施的反应。采用事件研究法，以标普500指数和斯托克欧洲600指数成分股为样本，我们得出三项主要发现。第一，CBAM的实施与正向的总体异常收益相关联，这与政策不确定性的消除相一致。第二，欧洲企业和受CBAM影响的行业在事件后平均回报率较低，反映了合规成本。第三，也是最重要的一点，地理位置与CBAM暴露度之间的交互作用表明，相较于美国同行，暴露度对欧洲企业的影响相对更为有利。这些结果表明，金融市场将CBAM视为一种碳负担和竞争机制，其影响主要集中在短期内。
title: Competitive Shield or Carbon Burden? Evidence from Equity Market Reactions to CBAM Enforcement
title_zh: 竞争盾牌还是碳负担？来自股票市场对CBAM实施反应的证据

abstract: Ensuring the provision of and access to ecosystem services is crucial to environmental health and human well-being. This study assesses the potential of urban green corridors (UGCs) to accommodate diverse interests, including by supplying ecosystem services, highlighting emerging socio-ecological conflicts. Five global UGCs are analysed as case studies through an ecosystem service assessment. A mixed qualitative and quantitative methodology is applied. The role of local communities is explored in context with the ecosystem service results. The key findings indicate that multiple ecosystem services such as local climate regulation, air quality regulation, flood protection, pollination, and recreational and aesthetic values can be supplied by these UGCs, while some provide educational and scientific research opportunities. However, the UGCs vary in their potential supply of ecosystem services due to unique case-specific characteristics. Achieving a balance between ecological and societal needs remains challenging due to conflicting interests, while infrastructure is often being prioritised, resulting in critical ecological impacts. Limited financial resources, expertise, and stakeholder collaboration challenge the long-term management of UGCs that impacts the supply of ecosystem services. The public's use of these spaces can result in disturbances and conflicts impacting the supply of ecosystem services. UGCs have the potential to serve as multifunctional spaces that address societal needs by providing ecosystem services and other benefits, such as connectivity and supporting social interaction and active mobility. However, further site-specific research is needed to investigate and enhance the supply of ecosystem services, including interactions between ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 确保生态系统服务的供给与获取对于环境健康和人类福祉至关重要。本研究评估了城市绿色廊道（UGCs）在容纳多元利益方面的潜力，包括通过提供生态系统服务，并凸显新兴的社会生态冲突。以五个全球城市绿色廊道为案例，通过生态系统服务评估进行分析。采用定性与定量相结合的混合方法。结合生态系统服务结果，探讨了当地社区的作用。主要发现表明，这些城市绿色廊道能够提供多种生态系统服务，如局部气候调节、空气质量调节、洪水防护、授粉以及休闲和美学价值，部分还提供教育和科学研究机会。然而，由于各案例特有的特征，城市绿色廊道在生态系统服务供给潜力上存在差异。由于利益冲突，实现生态与社会需求之间的平衡仍具挑战性，而基础设施往往被优先考虑，导致严重的生态影响。有限的财政资源、专业知识及利益相关者合作，对城市绿色廊道的长期管理构成挑战，进而影响生态系统服务的供给。公众对这些空间的使用可能导致干扰和冲突，影响生态系统服务的供给。城市绿色廊道有潜力作为多功能空间，通过提供生态系统服务及其他益处（如连通性、支持社会互动和积极出行）来满足社会需求。然而，仍需进一步针对具体地点的研究，以探究和增强生态系统服务的供给，包括生态系统服务之间的相互作用。
title: Ecosystem services supplied by urban green corridors with varying degrees of community involvement
title_zh: 不同社区参与程度的城市绿色廊道生态系统服务供给

abstract: This paper uses high-frequency public data to provide an ex-post evaluation of two floods that hit the Italian region of Emilia-Romagna in May 2023, just a few weeks after they occurred. Using nightlight data to measure output growth and considering a difference-in-differences empirical framework, we find a decline in nightlight growth in flooded municipalities in the three weeks surrounding the two floods, a rebound effect in the following three weeks, but no effect thereafter. In the most pessimistic scenario, the reduction in GDP growth in flooded municipalities in 2023 is between 0.3% and 0.8%, excluding the agricultural sector. The duration of the impact of the floods is broadly confirmed by the other two proxies for economic activity available at the daily frequence and municipal level, i.e. hiring and road traffic data. We also find temporary effects on the housing market demand, but no effects on the house prices asked by the sellers and the number of posted advertisements for house sales, suggesting that the housing market in flooded municipalities already discounts the risk of such natural events.
abstract_zh: 本文利用高频公共数据，对2023年5月袭击意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅大区的两次洪水进行了事后评估，评估时间距灾害发生仅数周。通过使用夜间灯光数据衡量产出增长，并采用双重差分实证框架，我们发现，在两次洪水发生后的三周内，受灾市镇的夜间灯光增长出现下降，随后三周出现反弹效应，但此后无显著影响。在最悲观情景下，2023年受灾市镇的GDP增长率下降幅度在0.3%至0.8%之间，不包括农业部门。洪水影响的持续时间大致得到了另外两个日频且市级层面的经济活动代理变量的证实，即招聘和道路交通数据。我们还发现住房市场需求受到暂时性影响，但对卖方挂牌房价及房屋销售广告数量无显著影响，这表明受灾市镇的住房市场已提前将此类自然灾害风险纳入考量。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: How to rapidly assess the economic consequences of floods with public data sources? evidence from northern Italy
title_zh: 如何利用公共数据源快速评估洪水的经济后果？来自意大利北部的证据

abstract: Students in low-income contexts often lack guidance in their career decisions, which can lead to a misallocation of educational investments. We report on a randomized field experiment conducted with 1715 students in rural Cambodia and show that a half-day career guidance workshop designed to support adolescents in developing occupational aspirations on average increased educational investments. We document substantial heterogeneity in treatment effects by baseline student performance. While the workshop increased schooling efforts of high-performing students, treated low-performing students reduced their educational investments. We develop a simple model that explains this treatment effect heterogeneity by baseline performance.
abstract_zh: 在低收入背景下的学生往往缺乏职业决策指导，这可能导致教育投资配置不当。我们报告了一项在柬埔寨农村对1715名学生进行的随机实地实验，结果显示，一个旨在支持青少年发展职业抱负的半日职业指导工作坊平均增加了教育投资。我们记录了基于基线学生表现的治疗效果显著异质性。尽管工作坊提高了高表现学生的学业努力，但受治疗的低表现学生减少了教育投资。我们构建了一个简单模型，通过基线表现来解释这种治疗效果的异质性。
title: Career guidance and investments in education: Experimental evidence from Cambodia
title_zh: 职业指导与教育投资：来自柬埔寨的实验证据

abstract: We study worker noncompete clauses in a large field experiment with two finance firms. Across ~14,000 job offers to freelance recruiters on short-term contracts, we randomize wages and the presence, salience, and duration of noncompetes (all contracts also included a nondisclosure agreement). Removing a noncompete increases mobility between competing employers by 36–52% and raises workers’ total earnings from the two firms by 12–17%. We find no evidence—rejecting even small effects—that removing noncompetes generates secret leakage. We also find no evidence that workers choose noncompete jobs for higher pay. Many workers appear unaware of noncompetes before firms’ post-employment communication. The results align with a model of inattention and uncertainty about enforcement.
abstract_zh: 我们在两家金融公司开展的大规模实地实验中研究了工人的竞业禁止条款。在向短期合同自由招聘人员发出的约14,000份工作邀请中，我们随机化了工资以及竞业禁止条款的存在性、显著性和持续时间（所有合同均包含保密协议）。移除竞业禁止条款使竞争雇主之间的流动性提高了36%-52%，并使工人在两家公司的总收益增加了12%-17%。我们没有发现任何证据——甚至拒绝了微小效应的存在——表明移除竞业禁止条款会导致秘密泄露。我们也没有发现工人为了更高薪酬而选择竞业禁止工作的证据。许多工人似乎在公司的雇佣后沟通之前对竞业禁止条款并不知情。这些结果与关于注意力不足和执行不确定性的模型相吻合。
title: Clause and Effect: Theory and Field Experimental Evidence on Noncompete Clauses
title_zh: 条款与效应：关于竞业禁止条款的理论与实地实验证据

abstract: We examine how the shapes of utility functions, particularly risk attitudes, influence Nash bargaining outcomes, thereby challenging the conventional assumption of risk neutrality. Our comparative static analysis reveals several key insights. (1) Changes in Pie Size: Increasing Absolute Risk Aversion (IARA) introduces an “equality bias,” which elucidates the fair distributions observed in unstructured bargaining experiments by emphasizing the role of participants’ risk attitudes. (2) Changes in Disagreement Point: IARA also results in low sensitivity, referred to as “insensitivity bias,” which contests the interpretation proposed by Anbarci and Feltovich (2013) by showing that concave IARA utility functions can adequately explain this insensitivity. These equality bias and insensitivity bias are closely interconnected phenomena. We propose a novel theoretical framework that elucidates the diverse outcomes of experimental bargaining through the lens of fundamental risk attitudes.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了效用函数形状，特别是风险态度，如何影响纳什谈判结果，从而挑战了风险中性的传统假设。我们的比较静态分析揭示了几个关键见解。(1) 馅饼大小的变化：递增绝对风险厌恶（IARA）引入了“平等偏见”，这通过强调参与者风险态度的作用，阐明了非结构化谈判实验中观察到的公平分配。(2) 分歧点的变化：IARA还导致低敏感性，称为“不敏感偏见”，这通过展示凹形IARA效用函数能够充分解释这种不敏感性，对Anbarci和Feltovich（2013）提出的解释提出了质疑。这些平等偏见和不敏感偏见是紧密相连的现象。我们提出了一种新颖的理论框架，通过基本风险态度的视角阐明了实验性谈判的多样化结果。
title: Comparative statics of Nash bargaining solution: Equality and insensitivity biases
title_zh: 纳什谈判解的比较静态分析：平等与不敏感偏差

abstract: We develop a real options model with finite-maturity debt to examine how rollover risk shapes the relative effectiveness of tax cuts and investment subsidies. Shorter debt maturity amplifies rollover risk, which strengthens the effectiveness of tax cuts while weakening that of investment subsidies. Under budget neutrality, tax cuts are always optimal. Under a net-subsidy regime, the optimal instrument is maturity-dependent: subsidies are optimal at long maturities, while as maturity shortens, a threshold tax rate emerges above which tax cuts are optimal and below which subsidies remain optimal. When maturity is sufficiently short, tax cuts dominate across all tax rates.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含有限期限债务的实物期权模型，以考察滚动风险如何影响减税与投资补贴的相对有效性。较短的债务期限会放大滚动风险，从而增强减税的效果，同时削弱投资补贴的作用。在预算中性条件下，减税始终是最优选择。在净补贴机制下，最优工具取决于债务期限：在长期限下，补贴为最优；随着期限缩短，会出现一个税率阈值，高于该阈值时减税为最优，低于该阈值时补贴仍为最优。当期限足够短时，减税在所有税率水平下均占优。
title: Policy incentives, firm investment, and debt rollover risk
title_zh: 政策激励、企业投资与债务展期风险

abstract: AI coding agents, general purpose assistants that write and execute code, make empirical specification search fast and cheap, but they also widen hidden researcher degrees of freedom. This paper adapts an open-source agent-loop architecture to an empirical economics workflow and adds a post-search holdout evaluation. In a forecast-combination illustration, independent agent searches find methods that improve on benchmarks from the original study. Logged search and holdout evaluation together make adaptive specification search more transparent and help distinguish robust improvements from sample-specific discoveries.
abstract_zh: AI编码代理，即编写并执行代码的通用助手，使得实证规格搜索变得快速且成本低廉，但同时也扩大了研究者隐藏的自由度。本文将开源代理循环架构适配至实证经济学工作流程，并增设搜索后保留样本评估环节。在预测组合的示例中，独立代理搜索发现的方法优于原始研究中的基准方法。结合日志记录的搜索过程与保留样本评估，使自适应规格搜索更加透明，并有助于区分稳健改进与样本特定发现。
title: An auditable AI agent loop for empirical economics: A case study in forecast combination
title_zh: 可审计的人工智能代理循环在实证经济学中的应用：预测组合的案例研究

abstract: Social media has created new, highly competitive markets for attention. But to what extent does attention on social media generate tangible economic returns and how are these returns characterized? Using a daily dataset of Twitter activity and campaign contributions for US Members of Congress (2019-2020), we show that attention on Twitter, as measured by likes, increases small donations. However, the effect is highly skewed: only a few members benefit substantially, consistent with a winner-takes-all market. These results are confirmed using a geography-based causal design tracking donation patterns across counties, showing that the increase in donations from attention on Twitter comes disproportionately from high Twitter usage areas.
abstract_zh: 社交媒体催生了新的、竞争激烈的注意力市场。然而，社交媒体上的注意力在多大程度上能转化为切实的经济回报，这些回报又具有怎样的特征？利用美国国会议员（2019-2020年）的推特活动与竞选捐款的日度数据集，我们表明，推特上的注意力（以点赞量衡量）会增加小额捐款。然而，这种效应高度偏斜：仅有少数议员获得显著收益，这与赢家通吃的市场特征相符。这些结果通过一项基于地理的因果设计得到证实，该设计追踪了各县的捐款模式，显示推特注意力带来的捐款增长不成比例地来自高推特使用率地区。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: The Returns to Viral Media: The Case of US Campaign Contributions,
title_zh: 病毒媒体的回报：美国竞选捐款的案例

abstract: Joint household decision-making becomes more common as economies develop. Can external intervention advance this transition? We study this question in the context of female employment in India. We randomized which spouse was given a ticket enabling enrollment in a women’s weaving job, and cross-randomized the other to receive no information about the ticket, information, or information and discussion with their spouse. Academic and local experts predict information and discussion should raise enrollment. Instead, information had no effect, and discussion reduced enrollment by 50%. We do not find an effect of giving the wife the job ticket rather than the husband. Our results show that interventions toward joint decision-making about an opportunity can lower take-up.
abstract_zh: 随着经济的发展，家庭联合决策变得越来越普遍。外部干预能否推动这一转变？我们在印度女性就业的背景下研究这一问题。我们随机分配了哪一方配偶获得一张可报名参加女性织布工作的票，并交叉随机分配另一方配偶分别处于三种情况：未获知票的信息、获知信息、或获知信息并与配偶讨论。学术专家和当地专家预测，信息与讨论应能提高报名率。然而，信息并未产生效果，而讨论则使报名率降低了50%。我们未发现将工作票给予妻子而非丈夫会产生影响。我们的结果表明，针对机会的联合决策干预措施可能降低参与率。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Coupling Labor Supply Decisions: An Experiment in India,
title_zh: 印度劳动力供给决策的耦合：一项实验研究

abstract: University access has significantly expanded in OECD countries, and further growth figures prominently in political agendas. We study possible consequences of historical and future expansions in a stochastic, general equilibrium Roy model where tertiary educational attainment is determined by cognitive ability and socioeconomic disadvantage. In our analysis, individual productivity depends not only on education but also directly on cognitive ability. The expansion of university access in the U.K. that started in the 1960s provides an ideal case study to draw lessons for the future. We find that this expansion led to the selection into college of progressively less talented students from advantaged backgrounds. Appropriate counterfactual policies existed that would have achieved the dual goal of increasing college graduates’ cognitive ability while improving tertiary education opportunities for the disadvantaged.
abstract_zh: 在OECD国家，大学入学机会已显著扩大，且进一步增长在政治议程中占据突出位置。我们研究历史和未来扩张在随机、一般均衡罗伊模型中的可能后果，其中高等教育成就由认知能力和社会经济劣势决定。在我们的分析中，个体生产力不仅取决于教育，还直接取决于认知能力。英国自20世纪60年代开始的大学入学扩张为未来提供了理想案例研究。我们发现，这一扩张导致来自优势背景的学生中，能力逐渐较低者被选拔进入大学。存在适当的反事实政策，本可实现增加大学毕业生认知能力与改善弱势群体高等教育机会的双重目标。
title: College, Cognitive Ability, and Socioeconomic Disadvantage: Policy Lessons from the U.K. in 1960–2004
title_zh: 大学、认知能力与社会经济劣势：1960—2004年英国的政策启示

abstract: We study the effect of reducing welfare assistance on migrants’ long-term integration in Australia. The reform applied to primary carers of children, delaying welfare benefit eligibility during their first two years in the country. Importantly, the reform was announced after migrants had arrived in Australia. Using a Regression Discontinuity Design and two decades of administrative welfare data, we find that the reform led to a significant and persistent reduction in overall welfare receipt up to 21 years after arrival, with effects that are particularly pronounced among migrants from more disadvantaged backgrounds. Increases in labour income were insufficient to offset the reduction in welfare benefits, and suggestive evidence indicates that migrants face a trade-off between higher-paying jobs and employment stability.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了减少福利援助对澳大利亚移民长期融入的影响。该改革针对儿童的主要照顾者，将他们在该国头两年的福利资格获取时间推迟。重要的是，这项改革是在移民抵达澳大利亚之后才宣布的。利用断点回归设计及二十年的行政福利数据，我们发现该改革导致移民在抵达后长达21年的总体福利领取显著且持续减少，这一效应在来自更弱势背景的移民中尤为明显。劳动收入的增加不足以弥补福利削减带来的损失，且初步证据表明，移民面临高薪工作与就业稳定性之间的权衡。
title: Welfare reform and migrants’ long-term labor market integration
title_zh: 福利改革与移民的长期劳动力市场融入

abstract: Foreign direct investment (FDI) in agriculture—particularly through large-scale land acquisitions—has become increasingly common across Africa. While existing studies have focused on the economic and environmental implications of these investments, their political effects remain underexplored. This study investigates how foreign land acquisitions shape citizens’ satisfaction with democracy in African democracies. By integrating spatial data from the Land Matrix with geo-referenced Afrobarometer survey responses (2002–2018), this study employs a difference-in-differences design to identify the causal impact of proximity to operational land deals. The findings suggest that foreign land acquisitions reduce democratic satisfaction through instrumental and intrinsic pathways. However, when local communities are meaningfully consulted, these negative effects are significantly mitigated. The results underscore that substantive consultation with local communities is a prerequisite for aligning foreign investment with sustainable development and inclusive growth, thereby offering new insights into how land-based FDI shapes democratic legitimacy in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 农业领域的外国直接投资（FDI）——尤其是通过大规模土地收购——在非洲日益普遍。尽管现有研究聚焦于这些投资的经济与环境影响，但其政治效应仍未得到充分探讨。本研究探讨外国土地收购如何影响非洲民主国家公民对民主的满意度。通过将Land Matrix的空间数据与地理参照的Afrobarometer调查数据（2002-2018年）相结合，本研究采用双重差分设计来识别接近运营中土地交易的因果影响。研究结果表明，外国土地收购通过工具性和内在性路径降低了民主满意度。然而，当地方社区被有意义地征询意见时，这些负面影响显著减弱。研究结果强调，与地方社区进行实质性磋商是将外国投资与可持续发展和包容性增长相结合的前提，从而为土地型外国直接投资如何塑造发展中国家的民主合法性提供了新的见解。
title: Sowing discontent: Foreign land acquisitions and satisfaction with democracy in Africa
title_zh: 播种不满：外国土地收购与非洲民主满意度

abstract: E-commerce platforms increasingly introduce private-label products that compete with green manufacturers’ products, while choosing among platform in-house production, outsourcing to green manufacturers, and outsourcing to OEM manufacturers. This study develops a game-theoretic model to examine how selling modes and production strategies affect green technology investment, platform–manufacturer cooperation, and private-label production choices, considering private-label market size, competition intensity, and consumer green preferences. Results show that when private-label market size exceeds a critical threshold, platform in-house production becomes optimal under both reselling and agency selling, with a lower threshold under reselling. As competition intensifies, green manufacturers reduce green technology investment. The platform adjusts its production strategy according to the cost difference between in-house production and outsourcing. From a supply chain perspective, agency selling achieves Pareto improvement over reselling within intermediate commission-rate ranges when no private label is introduced, production is in-house, or production is outsourced to green manufacturers. However, under outsourcing to OEM manufacturers, reselling achieves a win–win outcome over agency selling within an intermediate commission-rate range. KEYWORDS: Platform sales mode private-label production mode green manufacturer JEL CLASSIFICATION: L81 L13 Q56
abstract_zh: 电商平台日益引入自有品牌产品，与绿色制造商的产品形成竞争，同时需在平台自产、外包给绿色制造商及外包给OEM制造商之间做出选择。本研究构建博弈论模型，考察销售模式与生产策略如何影响绿色技术投资、平台与制造商合作及自有品牌生产选择，并考虑自有品牌市场规模、竞争强度及消费者绿色偏好等因素。研究结果表明，当自有品牌市场规模超过临界阈值时，平台自产在转售模式和代理销售模式下均为最优选择，且转售模式下的阈值更低。随着竞争加剧，绿色制造商减少绿色技术投资。平台根据自产与外包之间的成本差异调整其生产策略。从供应链视角看，在不引入自有品牌、采用自产或外包给绿色制造商的情况下，代理销售在中等佣金率区间内相对于转售模式实现帕累托改进。然而，在外包给OEM制造商的情形下，转售模式在中等佣金率区间内相对于代理销售实现双赢结果。关键词：平台销售模式；自有品牌生产模式；绿色制造商 JEL分类：L81 L13 Q56

title: Platform private-label production modes and manufacturer sales strategy choices under green product competition

abstract: This study estimates the effects of an employment programme for disadvantaged unemployed individuals. The programme emphasized on‐the‐job training and contracting the unemployed for a few paid weekly work hours as a stepping stone into the labour market. Evaluated through a randomized controlled trial with 3,727 participants, the programme was found to accelerate transitions into part‐time work. Contrary to its intention, it permanently increased the share of participants receiving disability pensions among most disadvantaged groups. To explain this finding, we suggest that training, while enhancing productivity for some, simultaneously provided information of employability used in the assessment of disability pension eligibility.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了一项针对弱势失业者的就业计划的效果。该计划强调在职培训，并安排失业者每周从事数小时的有偿工作，作为进入劳动力市场的跳板。通过一项包含3，727名参与者的随机对照试验评估，发现该计划加速了向兼职工作的转变。与预期相反，它在大多数最弱势群体中永久性地提高了领取残疾抚恤金的参与者比例。为解释这一发现，我们认为培训在提升部分人生产力的同时，也提供了用于评估残疾抚恤金资格的可就业性信息。
title: Stepping stone or exit path: experimental evidence on training the long‐term unemployed
title_zh: 垫脚石还是退出通道：针对长期失业者培训的实验证据

abstract: We consider two-stage parallel contests with a finite set of agents, as well as a finite set of heterogeneous contests with varying winning prizes. In the first stage, each agent simultaneously chooses in which contest he wants to compete, and in the second stage, the agents who chose the same contest compete against each other in a contest for a single prize. We first assume a general Tullock contest success function with nonlinear cost functions, and then we present an algorithm that converges to equilibrium, namely, the algorithm organizes the allocation of homogeneous or heterogeneous agents of two types, each with a different cost of effort, among the contests until no agent wishes to change his current contest. Later, we assume the Tullock contest success function with linear cost functions, and we show that for homogeneous agents, our model and a potential game are equivalent, allowing us to explicitly characterize the subgame perfect equilibrium with pure strategies.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个包含有限数量参与者的两阶段并行竞赛模型，以及一系列奖品各异的异质性竞赛。在第一阶段，每位参与者同时选择想要参加的竞赛；在第二阶段，选择同一竞赛的参与者们为争夺单一奖品而相互竞争。我们首先假设采用具有非线性成本函数的通用Tullock竞赛成功函数，随后提出一种收敛至均衡的算法，即该算法组织同质或异质的两类参与者（每类具有不同的努力成本）在竞赛间进行分配，直至没有参与者希望更换其当前竞赛。接着，我们假设采用具有线性成本函数的Tullock竞赛成功函数，并证明对于同质参与者，我们的模型与一个势博弈等价，从而能够明确刻画纯策略下的子博弈完美均衡。
title: An algorithmic analysis of parallel contests
title_zh: 并行竞赛的算法分析

abstract: The slow adoption of wagon transport in the Andes is a puzzle. We examine it by developing a threshold technology-adoption model calibrated using human and mule energy consumption and unique historical data from a human trail and the first wagon road in the Andes. Model predictions align with historical social choices. Pre-Columbians selected a straight, steep, short route for human porters to reduce energy costs, while the Spanish used it with mule packs. Late nineteenth-century transport demand growth surpassed the model’s threshold and contributed to construction of the zigzagging, gentle, long wagon road route, as well as incentives to build state capacity.
abstract_zh: 安第斯地区马车运输的缓慢采用是一个谜团。我们通过构建一个阈值技术采纳模型来探究此问题，该模型利用人力和骡马能量消耗数据以及来自安第斯地区一条人行小道和首条马车道路的独特历史数据进行校准。模型预测与历史上的社会选择相吻合。前哥伦布时期的人们选择了一条笔直、陡峭且路程较短的人行路线，以降低人力搬运者的能量成本，而西班牙人则利用此路线进行骡马驮运。19世纪末，运输需求的增长超过了模型的阈值，这不仅促进了蜿蜒平缓的长距离马车道路的建设，也激发了构建国家能力的动力。
title: Why Was the Wheel (Not) Used in the Andes? A Hypothesis Explaining the Slow Adoption of Wagon Transport and Evidence from Nineteenth-Century Colombia
title_zh: 为何安第斯山脉（未）使用轮子？——解释货车运输缓慢采用的一个假说及来自十九世纪哥伦比亚的证据

abstract: We study how anti-fascist opposition during Mussolini’s dictatorship affects post-war support for right-wing parties in Italy. We construct a measure of anti-fascism from the universe of recorded opponents, and use newly digitized historical data to resolve simultaneity between the supply of opposition and the demand for repression, leveraging the random assignment of judges to the Special Tribunal for the Defense of the State. Stronger local opposition leads to weaker support for right-wing parties decades later. Our model generates predictions about underlying mechanisms, tested using data on collective memorialization and parental voting behavior. The main driver is social transmission of political preferences.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了墨索里尼独裁时期反法西斯反对派如何影响战后意大利对右翼政党的支持。我们根据所有记录在案的反对者构建了一个反法西斯主义衡量指标，并利用新近数字化的历史数据，通过随机分配法官至国家防御特别法庭来解决反对派供给与镇压需求之间的同时性问题。地方反对力量越强，数十年后对右翼政党的支持就越弱。我们的模型生成了关于潜在机制的预测，并通过集体纪念活动和父母投票行为的数据进行了检验。主要驱动因素是政治偏好的社会传递。
title: Historical Anti-Fascism and Right-Wing Voting in Italy
title_zh: 意大利历史上的反法西斯主义与右翼投票

abstract: The role of Common Pool natural Resources (CPRs) such as forests, grasslands, rivers, lakes, wetlands and oceans in rural economies has been much debated in the literature, often on the basis of micro-level or provincial-scale analyses and focusing on a single type of CPR, typically forests. This study draws on data from 6,509 households across fifteen regions in nine low and middle-income countries covering Africa, Asia, and Latin America that also cover a diverse set of CPRs, including forests, savannas, grasslands, mangroves and inland and marine fisheries. We estimate the contribution of CPR-based income to total household income and vis-a-vis the poverty line across income classes, and analyse the correlates of CPR-based income and the relationship between CPR income and income inequality within rural settlements. Our results highlight three important aspects of the CPR-rural income relationship. First, they confirm that CPR-based income makes up a significant portion of the income of the rural poor even across diverse geographies and CPRs. Households below the World Bank $1.9 per capita per day poverty line derive on average one fourth of their household income from CPRs. Second, the regression results highlight the importance of physical resource abundance and social accessibility, household demography, the regional demographic/market context, and most importantly the complementary productive assets owned by households in deriving income from CPRs. Third, there is a distinct correlation between the broad nature of CPR harvest technologies and income-inequality: when the harvest technology is capital-intensive, richer households derive more monetary benefit from CPRs, not only in absolute terms but also in terms of share in household income, leading to a situation where such CPRs exacerbate inequality within settlements. Our results highlight the importance of integrating a diversity of CPRs and CPR availability, access and technological context into CPR studies. They also highlight the need for pro-poor policies that go beyond securing resource access and include support for the poor to access technologies and markets.
abstract_zh: 诸如森林、草地、河流、湖泊、湿地和海洋等公共池资源（CPRs）在农村经济中的作用，在文献中一直备受争议，这些讨论往往基于微观层面或省级尺度的分析，并聚焦于单一类型的CPR，尤其是森林。本研究利用来自非洲、亚洲和拉丁美洲九个中低收入国家十五个地区的6509户家庭数据，这些数据覆盖了包括森林、稀树草原、草地、红树林以及内陆和海洋渔业在内的多种CPR类型。我们估算了基于CPR的收入对家庭总收入的贡献，并对照贫困线分析了不同收入阶层的情况，同时探讨了CPR收入的相关因素以及CPR收入与农村居民点内部收入不平等之间的关系。我们的研究结果凸显了CPR与农村收入关系的三个重要方面。首先，研究证实，即使在不同地理环境和CPR类型下，基于CPR的收入在农村贫困人口收入中占据重要份额。低于世界银行每人每天1.9美元贫困线的家庭，平均约有四分之一的家庭收入来源于CPR。其次，回归结果强调了物质资源丰富度和社会可及性、家庭人口特征、区域人口/市场背景，以及最为关键的家庭所拥有的互补性生产资产在从CPR获取收入中的重要性。第三，CPR收获技术的广泛性质与收入不平等之间存在显著相关性：当收获技术为资本密集型时，较富裕的家庭从CPR中获得的货币收益更多，不仅在绝对数额上，而且在家庭收入占比上也是如此，从而导致此类CPR加剧了居民点内部的不平等。我们的研究结果强调了将CPR的多样性、可用性、获取途径和技术背景纳入CPR研究的重要性，同时也凸显了制定有利于贫困人口政策的必要性，这些政策不仅要确保资源获取，还要支持贫困人口获得技术和市场准入。
title: How do common pool natural resources relate to rural income, poverty and inequality? A multi-country assessment
title_zh: 共同资源性自然资源与农村收入、贫困和不平等的关系：一项跨国评估

abstract: Since 2010, a growing proportion of doctoral graduates have been taking jobs outside academia. This column explores where elite early-career economists work, using a dataset covering all PhD graduates from US economics programmes. The findings revealt that recent elite PhD graduates are more likely to leave academia, to take jobs outside the US, and to be absorbed by a tech sector that draws broadly across gender, ethnicity, and programme prestige. However, East Asian candidates continue to face a substantial penalty in access to top academic positions. Within academia, elite advisor networks continue to confer advantages, reinforcing stratification at the top.
abstract_zh: 自2010年以来，越来越多的博士毕业生选择在学术界之外就业。本文利用涵盖美国经济学项目所有博士毕业生的数据集，探讨了精英早期职业经济学家的就业去向。研究发现，近年来，精英博士毕业生更倾向于离开学术界，前往美国以外地区工作，并被科技行业广泛吸纳，这一趋势跨越了性别、种族及项目声望的界限。然而，东亚候选人在获取顶尖学术职位方面仍面临显著劣势。在学术界内部，精英导师网络持续带来优势，加剧了顶层的分层现象。
authors: Markus Eberhardt, Giovanni Facchini, Valeria Rueda
title: Expanding opportunities: Economics PhD placement in the 21st century
title_zh: 扩大机会：21世纪经济学博士就业去向

abstract: This paper studies robust mechanism design in bilateral trade under limited information. I introduce a new class of mechanisms in which the buyer and seller submit a bid and an ask, and trade occurs when the bid–ask difference exceeds a random spread drawn from a publicly known distribution. Conditional on trade, the asset is sold at the midpoint price, and each trader pays the same commission, which depends on the bid–ask difference through a function determined by the random spread distribution. I show that these mechanisms, termed generalized double auctions, are strategy-proof and include both welfare-guarantee-maximizing and profit-guarantee-maximizing mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了信息有限条件下双边贸易中的稳健机制设计。我引入了一类新型机制，其中买方和卖方分别提交出价与要价，当买卖价差超过一个由公开已知分布随机抽取的价差时，交易发生。在交易条件下，资产以中间价出售，每位交易者支付相同的佣金，该佣金通过由随机价差分布决定的函数依赖于买卖价差。我证明，这些被称为广义双重拍卖的机制是策略-proof的，并包含了最大化福利保障和最大化利润保障的机制。
title: Generalized Double Auctions: Maximizing Welfare Guarantees in Bilateral Trade
title_zh: 广义双重拍卖：双边贸易中福利保障的最大化

abstract: 科学识别并合理布局产业创新赛道，是破除产业“内卷式”竞争、推动产业高质量发展的关键。本文从生产能力边界约束产业创新视角，构建嵌入复杂性租金与搜寻匹配摩擦的“收益—风险”权衡的产业跃迁模型，并据此建立地区产业创新赛道识别框架；进一步将地区间能力优势互补纳入分析，揭示其对弥补本地能力缺口的作用。研究发现，能力支撑能够促进地区产业创新；脱离本地能力支撑、盲目追求高复杂性产业，会扩大能力缺口并抑制产业创新...
